name: Rotating Residential
desc: Rotate residential network exits according to your configuration for data access tasks that require changing connections.
scenario: Public data collection, price monitoring and market research
focus: Review rotation rules, session duration, data packages and available locations.
checks: Confirm required locations and available resources
Review rotation and session persistence rules
Check data package validity and how usage is measured

name: Static Residential
desc: Use a relatively fixed residential network exit for workflows that need session continuity.
scenario: Persistent sessions, business system access and website experience checks
focus: Confirm locations, IP allocation and the service period, then test in your environment.
checks: Confirm locations and the number of IPs needed
Check service periods and renewal rules
Test whether a fixed exit meets your session requirements
billing: Per IP and selected service period

name: Mobile Proxies
desc: Connect through mobile networks for mobile experience checks and application testing.
scenario: Mobile app testing, page checks and ad display monitoring
focus: Confirm locations, network types and how your testing tools will connect.
checks: Confirm available locations and network types
Review session settings and connection protocols
Review data usage rules and testing requirements

name: Datacenter Proxies
desc: Connect through datacenter networks for authorized automation and routine data access.
scenario: System integration testing, authorized automation and routine data access
focus: For workflows that do not require a residential or mobile network environment.
checks: Confirm locations, IP quantities and service periods
Check protocols and authentication methods
Test within the target service access rules
billing: Per IP and selected service period

name: Daily Residential
desc: Choose daily static residential plans by location and validity period, and review connection details and expiry times.
scenario: Residential network access scheduled around task duration
focus: The selected plan determines validity. Confirm renewal and expiry arrangements in advance.
checks: Choose locations and the planned number of IPs
Check plan validity and expiry times
Confirm connection, renewal and replacement rules
billing: Per IP; plan validity is listed separately

name: Live Connection
desc: IP plans for live streaming workflows, configured by location and service period.
scenario: Network exit configuration and connection management for live streaming
focus: Check suitability against your streaming platform, locations and actual workflow.
checks: Confirm target locations and the streaming use case
Review IP quantities and service periods
Review connection details and test the use case
billing: Per IP; plan duration is listed separately

name: Bandwidth Plans
desc: Choose a plan by bandwidth tier and duration, and manage proxy settings through an Unlimited KEY.
scenario: Proxy tasks planned around bandwidth and duration
focus: Confirm the scope and limits of “unlimited” usage in the selected plan and service terms.
checks: Confirm bandwidth tiers and hourly or daily plans
Review KEY, session and location settings
Check plan scope and usage rules
billing: By selected hourly or daily plan; bandwidth tier is listed separately

name: Short-Term Residential
desc: Purchase an IP quota, generate short-term residential proxies, and review generation records and expiry times.
scenario: Workflows that generate residential proxies in task batches
focus: Actual validity depends on the generation record and selected plan.
checks: Confirm required locations and generation quantities
Review IP quotas and usage methods
Review generation records and expiry details
